answer: The vertex schedule is applied in lotus and dawn reveals each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4219 identities would post 3154 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
